def bind_step_grounding(
    original: VisualOriginalPlan,
    *,
    original_step_id: str,
    grounded_step: TaskStep,
    online: OnlineEvidenceSnapshot,
    source_checkpoint: ExecutionCheckpoint,
    current_identity: VisualOwnerIdentity,
    owner_revision: int,
    state_generation: int,
    grounding_inputs: GroundingFrameInputs,
    grounding_policy: DeterministicGroundingPolicy,
    now: datetime,
    required_duration_s: float | None = None,
    duration_check: GroundingDurationCheck | None = None,
) -> StepGroundingBinding:
    local = type(original) is LocalVisualOriginalPlan
    original = (LocalVisualOriginalPlan.from_payload(original.to_payload()) if local
                else freeze_original_visual_plan(**original.freeze_inputs()))
    now = _aware(now)
    if current_identity != original.identity:
        raise ValueError("foreign job/epoch/robot owner identity")
    _counter(owner_revision)
    _counter(state_generation)
    _counter(online.plan_version)
    _counter(online.command_seq)
    cp = ExecutionCheckpoint.model_validate_json(
        _model_json(source_checkpoint, ExecutionCheckpoint)
    )
    cp_hash = checkpoint_digest(cp)
    if not _aware(cp.created_at) <= _aware(cp.updated_at) or (not local and _aware(cp.updated_at) > now):
        raise ValueError("current checkpoint timestamp is future or reversed")
    contract = original.contract
    observation = RGBDObservation.model_validate_json(
        _model_json(online.observation, RGBDObservation)
    )
    _model_json(online.robot_state, type(online.robot_state))
    if (
        cp.checkpoint_hash != cp_hash
        or online.context_hash != cp_hash
        or cp.task_id != contract.task_id
        or cp.plan_id != current_identity.plan_id
        or cp.robot_id != current_identity.robot_id
        or (cp.plan_version, cp.command_seq) != (contract.plan_version, contract.command_seq)
        or (online.plan_version, online.command_seq)
        != (contract.plan_version, contract.command_seq)
        or observation.episode_id != current_identity.episode_id
    ):
        raise ValueError("current checkpoint/version/episode/context mismatch")
    ids = [s.step_id for s in contract.steps]
    completed = cp.completed_step_ids
    if (
        ids[: len(completed)] != completed
        or cp.pending_step_ids != ids[len(completed) :]
        or cp.current_step_index != len(completed)
        or not cp.pending_step_ids
        or cp.current_step_id != cp.pending_step_ids[0]
        or original_step_id != cp.current_step_id
        or cp.execution_state in {"COMPLETED", "SAFETY_STOPPED"}
    ):
        raise ValueError("current pending cursor or completed effects mismatch")
    requirement = original.requirements[original_step_id]
    inputs, policy = grounding_inputs, grounding_policy
    if (
        inputs.observation_id != observation.observation_id
        or inputs.observation_checksum_sha256 != observation.checksum_sha256
        or inputs.episode_id != observation.episode_id
        or inputs.calibration_version != observation.calibration_version
    ):
        raise ValueError("grounding frame/checksum/calibration binding mismatch")
    if any(
        c.tolerances.get("calibration_version", observation.calibration_version)
        != observation.calibration_version
        for c in (*requirement.preconditions, *requirement.postconditions)
    ):
        raise ValueError("registered canonical calibration differs from current frame")
    for sources in (inputs.source_hashes, policy.source_hashes):
        if any(original.source_hashes.get(k) != v for k, v in sources.items()):
            raise ValueError("deterministic grounding source identity mismatch")
    if (
        policy.tcp_velocity > contract.safety_constraints.max_tcp_velocity
        or policy.minimum_height_m < contract.safety_constraints.minimum_safe_height
    ):
        raise ValueError("grounding cannot relax original safety policy")
    stored = _model_json(grounded_step, TaskStep)
    step, expected = TaskStep.model_validate_json(stored), requirement.original_step
    if (
        step.step_id != expected.step_id
        or step.skill != expected.skill
        or step.expected_duration_ms != expected.expected_duration_ms
        or step.timeout_ms != expected.timeout_ms
        or step.retry_limit != expected.retry_limit
        or step.preconditions
        or step.success_conditions
        or step.parameters != _resolved_parameters(expected, original, online, inputs, policy)
    ):
        raise ValueError("grounded view changed original policy or deterministic parameters")
    max_ages = [
        _positive(c.tolerances.get("max_age_s", requirement.ordinary_ttl_s))
        for c in (*requirement.preconditions, *requirement.postconditions)
    ]
    if not local:
        expires = min(original.effective_deadline_at,
            observation.captured_at + timedelta(seconds=min(requirement.ordinary_ttl_s, *max_ages)))
        if not original.registered_at <= observation.captured_at <= now < expires:
            raise ValueError("original absolute/frame deadline expired or future")
    duration = (
        requirement.expected_duration_s
        if required_duration_s is None
        else _positive(required_duration_s)
    )
    if duration < max(
        requirement.expected_duration_s, max(step.expected_duration_ms, step.timeout_ms) / 1000
    ):
        raise ValueError("duration cannot understate checked original horizon")
    if duration > requirement.expected_duration_s:
        check = duration_check
        if (
            not isinstance(check, GroundingDurationCheck)
            or check._grounded_step_json != stored
            or check.observation_id != observation.observation_id
            or check.observation_checksum_sha256 != observation.checksum_sha256
            or check.original_plan_hash != original.digest()
            or check.grounding_policy_hash != policy.digest()
            or check.expected_duration_s != duration
            or not observation.captured_at <= check.checked_at <= now
            or any(original.source_hashes.get(k) != v for k, v in check.source_hashes.items())
        ):
            raise ValueError("longer duration requires fresh exact source calculation binding")
    calculation = duration_check if duration > requirement.expected_duration_s else None
    bound_sources = {**policy.source_hashes, **grounding_inputs.source_hashes}
    if calculation is not None:
        bound_sources.update(calculation.source_hashes)
    if local:
        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.vision.operational_windows import _LOCAL_RUNTIMES

        candidates = [runtime for runtime in tuple(_LOCAL_RUNTIMES.values())
                      if runtime.original.digest() == original.digest()]
        if len(candidates) != 1:
            raise ValueError("grounding requires the unique original private runtime")
        return candidates[0]._local_bind_grounding({
            "binding_scope": "DURABLE_BINDING_ONLY", "original_plan_hash": original.digest(),
            "current_identity": current_identity.to_payload(), "original_requirements": requirement.to_payload(),
            "owner_revision": owner_revision, "state_generation": state_generation,
            "source_checkpoint_hash": cp_hash, "observation_id": observation.observation_id,
            "observation_checksum_sha256": observation.checksum_sha256,
            "calibration_version": observation.calibration_version or "", "plan_version": contract.plan_version,
            "command_seq": contract.command_seq, "grounding_policy_hash": policy.digest(),
            "grounding_inputs_hash": grounding_inputs.digest(),
            "duration_check_hash": calculation.digest() if calculation is not None else None,
            "grounding_source_hashes": bound_sources, "grounded_step": json.loads(stored),
            "expected_duration_s": duration}, observation)
    return StepGroundingBinding(
        original.digest(),
        current_identity,
        requirement,
        owner_revision,
        state_generation,
        cp_hash,
        observation.observation_id,
        observation.checksum_sha256,
        observation.calibration_version or "",
        contract.plan_version,
        contract.command_seq,
        policy.digest(),
        grounding_inputs.digest(),
        calculation.digest() if calculation is not None else None,
        MappingProxyType(bound_sources),
        stored,
        duration,
        now,
        expires,
    )

definitions.name: VisualWorkerRuntime._initialize_local
definitions.source:
def _initialize_local(self, episode_id, instruction, model_hash, limits):
        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.vision.local_temporal import bootstrap_source_commitment
        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.vision.operational_windows import _descriptor_plain, _register_local_original

        owner = self._operational_owner
        self._local_task_id = episode_id
        self._local_session = owner._startup.worker._operational_lease_session
        lease = self._read_lease()
        self._frozen_job_configuration_hash = digest(self._job_configuration())
        self._bootstrap_id = digest(["visual.bootstrap.job-run.v1", self.source.job_id, self.source.run_id])
        reference = _descriptor_plain(owner.export_record(owner.task_window))
        domain = _descriptor_plain(asdict(owner._clock.domain))
        origin_event_id = owner.task_origin_token.event_identity
        effective = self._local_definition_limits(limits, reference)
        startup = owner._startup
        if (type(owner) is not OperationalWindowOwner or not self._local_mode
                or startup.mode != "LOCAL_TEMPORAL_PUBLICATION_V1" or owner._closed
                or _OWNERS.get(startup.worker) is not owner
                or startup.thread_id != threading.get_ident()
                or startup.binding is not self.role_binding
                or startup.worker.visual_role_binding is not self.role_binding
                or startup.repository is not self.source.job_repository
                or startup.worker.repository is not startup.repository
                or startup.worker.active_job_id != startup.job_id
                or startup.worker._frozen_operational_time_mode != startup.mode
                or (self.source.job_id, self.source.run_id, self.source.worker_id, self.source.lease_id)
                != (startup.job_id, startup.run_id, startup.worker.worker_id, startup.lease_id)
                or reference["domain"] != domain
                or reference["task_origin_event_id"] != origin_event_id
                or reference["episode_id"] != episode_id
                or reference["source_hashes"] != dict(self.source.source_hashes)
                or reference["source_identity"] != owner._source_identity
                or (reference["job_id"], reference["run_id"], reference["worker_id"],
                    reference["lease_id"], reference["attempt"], reference["fencing"])
                != (startup.job_id, startup.run_id, startup.worker.worker_id,
                    startup.lease_id, startup.attempt, str(startup.acquired_at))
                or _seconds_ns(self.source.task_timeout_s) != startup.task_ns
                or _seconds_ns(limits.deadline_s) != startup.verification_ns
                or reference["budget_ns"] != startup.task_ns
                or {row["source_id"]: row["budget_ns"] for row in reference["hard_deadlines"]}
                != {startup.job_source + ":task": startup.task_ns,
                    startup.binding_hash + ":verification": startup.verification_ns}):
            raise ValueError("local definition requires the exact original startup obligations")
        definition_body = {"scope": "BOOTSTRAP_SOURCE_ONLY", "episode_id": episode_id,
                           "user_instruction": instruction, "task_timeout_s": self.source.task_timeout_s,
                           "verification_limits": asdict(effective), "role_bundle_hash": self._role_hash,
                           "model_snapshot_hash": model_hash, "source_hashes": dict(self.source.source_hashes)}
        self._local_original = _descriptor_plain({
            "schema_version": "visual.local-original-time.v1", "app_domain": domain,
            "task_origin_event_id": origin_event_id,
            "task_reference": reference, "verification_reference": reference, "recovery_reference": reference,
            "lease_identity": {"job_id": self.source.job_id, "run_id": self.source.run_id,
                               "worker_id": self.source.worker_id, "lease_id": self.source.lease_id,
                               "attempt": lease.attempt, "epoch": self._local_session.epoch,
                               "source_identity": lease.source_identity,
                               "original_acquisition": _descriptor_plain(lease.original_acquisition)},
            "source_hashes": dict(self.source.source_hashes),
            "contract_provenance": {"kind": "LOCAL_BOOTSTRAP_SOURCE_V1",
                                    "content_sha256": bootstrap_source_commitment(definition_body)},
        })
        owner._local_original = self._local_original
        definition = VisualBootstrapDefinition.from_payload(self._local_envelope(
            "visual.bootstrap.definition.local.v1", definition_body))
        _register_local_original(owner, definition.local_time.to_payload())
        with self._local_publication_scope(operation_id="bootstrap-init:" + self._bootstrap_id,
                                           operation_sha256=_local_digest(definition)):
            self.source.event_repository.initialize_visual_bootstrap_if_absent(definition)
        self._last_observation = self.bootstrap.observation

def _local_adopt(self, robot_state):
        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.repositories.event_autonomy.visual_bootstrap import compile_local_bootstrap_original
        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.edge.recovery.lifecycle import LocalRetryBudgetRecord
        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.vision.local_temporal import _hash, _history_state_hash, semantic_projection

        self.check_active(robot_state)
        if self.is_adopted:
            return self.original.contract, self.publication
        pre = self.bootstrap
        original = compile_local_bootstrap_original(pre, plan_id=self.source.plan_id, robot_id=self.source.robot_id)
        contract, state = original.contract, pre.local_state
        limits = state.limits
        retry_body = {"budget_id": "bootstrap-retry-" + self._bootstrap_id[:32], "task_id": contract.task_id,
                      "per_step_retry_limit": max(step.retry_limit for step in contract.steps),
                      "per_skill_retry_limit": contract.failure_policy.local_retry_limit,
                      "task_total_retry_limit": limits.max_retries, "retry_count_used": 0,
                      "task_retry_count": 0, "step_retry_counts": {}, "skill_retry_counts": {},
                      "event_retry_counts": {}, "retry_cooldown_ms": 0, "retry_backoff_policy": "NONE",
                      "effective_retry_limit": limits.max_retries, "remaining_retries": state.remaining_retries,
                      "scene_version": contract.scene_version}
        # A pool is a result/evidence envelope; its live commit evidence is added
        # by the real coordinator, before decoding or persistence.
        now = datetime.now(UTC)
        checkpoint = ExecutionCheckpoint(
            checkpoint_id="visual-initial-" + self._bootstrap_id[:32], task_id=contract.task_id,
            plan_id=original.identity.plan_id, robot_id=original.identity.robot_id,
            plan_version=contract.plan_version, command_seq=contract.command_seq, scene_version=contract.scene_version,
            current_step_id=contract.steps[0].step_id, pending_step_ids=[step.step_id for step in contract.steps],
            robot_state=robot_state.model_dump(mode="json"), created_at=now, updated_at=now)
        checkpoint = checkpoint.model_copy(update={"checkpoint_hash": checkpoint_digest(checkpoint)})
        body = {"scope": "BOOTSTRAP_SOURCE_ONLY", "bootstrap_id": self._bootstrap_id,
                "definition_hash": _hash(pre.to_payload()["payload"]["definition"]),
                "expected_record_hash": _history_state_hash(pre._tag, pre.semantic, self._local_original),
                "event_key": "worker-adopt-" + str(pre.revision), "original": original.to_payload(),
                "robot_state": robot_state.model_dump(mode="json")}
        promotion = VisualBootstrapPromotionInput.from_payload(self._local_envelope(
            "visual.bootstrap.promotion.local.v1", body))
        operation_hash = _local_digest(promotion)
        with self._local_publication_scope(operation_id=body["event_key"], operation_sha256=operation_hash) as scope:
            decision, transaction = self._local_transaction(scope, promotion._tag, pre.revision,
                _hash({"schema_version": "visual.local-history-operation.v1", "request": semantic_projection(promotion.to_payload())}))
            retry = LocalRetryBudgetRecord.from_payload(self._local_envelope(
                "recovery.retry-budget.local.v1", retry_body, decision, transaction))
            publication = self.source.event_repository.initialize_visual_owner_if_absent(
                original, checkpoint, state, retry, bootstrap_promotion=promotion)
        self._can_capture_effects = True
        return contract, publication

definitions.name: VisualWorkerRuntime._local_bind_grounding
definitions.source:
def _local_bind_grounding(self, body, observation):
        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.vision.owner_registration import LocalStepGroundingBinding
        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.vision.local_temporal import _hash
        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.repositories.event_autonomy.protocol import local_get_unlocked

        if sys._getframe(1).f_code is not bind_step_grounding.__code__:
            raise RuntimeError("grounding must retain the complete deterministic producer checks")
        publication = self.publication
        if (body["original_plan_hash"] != self.original.digest()
                or body["owner_revision"] != publication.owner_revision
                or body["state_generation"] != publication.state_generation + 1
                or body["source_checkpoint_hash"] != publication.checkpoint.checkpoint_hash
                or self._last_observation is None
                or observation.model_dump(mode="json") != self._last_observation.model_dump(mode="json")):
            raise RuntimeError("grounding actual current publication/frame source differs")
        requirement = self.original.requirements[publication.checkpoint.current_step_id]
        ttl = min(requirement.ordinary_ttl_s,
                  *(condition.tolerances.get("max_age_s", 5.0)
                    for condition in (*requirement.preconditions, *requirement.postconditions)))
        _bind_observation_policy(self._operational_owner, observation, "grounding", ttl,
                                 {"requirement": requirement.to_payload()})
        if _check_observation(observation, "grounding", max_age_s=ttl) is not True:
            raise RuntimeError("grounding original acquisition window unavailable")
        operation = digest(["worker-grounding-binding", body])
        with self._local_publication_scope(operation_id="grounding-bind:" + operation,
                                           operation_sha256=operation) as scope:
            if self.publication.digest() != publication.digest():
                raise RuntimeError("grounding publication changed after both locks")
            existing = local_get_unlocked(self.source.event_repository, "grounding", operation)
            if existing is not None:
                prior = LocalStepGroundingBinding.from_payload(existing)
                if prior.semantic != body or prior.transaction.to_payload()["phase"] != "COMPLETE":
                    raise RuntimeError("grounding historical source is changed or incomplete")
                return prior
            decision, transaction = self._local_transaction(scope, "visual.owner.grounding.local.v1",
                                                            publication.owner_revision, operation)
            transaction["event_record_hash"] = _hash(body)
            binding = LocalStepGroundingBinding.from_payload(self._local_envelope(
                "visual.owner.grounding.local.v1", body, decision, transaction))
            final = self._local_commit(scope, {"grounding": {"key": operation, "value": binding.to_payload()}}, transaction)
            return LocalStepGroundingBinding.from_payload(final["grounding"]["value"])
